text: Breitling SA, until 2017 a family-owned Swiss luxury watchmaker, had CVC Fund VI agree on 28 April 2017 to acquire an 80% stake, with Théodore Schneider re-investing for the remaining 20%. (This source does not cover the later increase to 100% ownership or CVC's corporate/listing structure.)

source.name: CVC Capital Partners: CVC Fund VI agrees to acquire majority stake in Breitling SA
source.quote: CVC Fund VI has agreed to acquire an 80% stake in Breitling SA
